issues.description: The problem statement is internally inconsistent about the SealSaloon.stock attribute: one section describes it as an instance field initialized in the constructor (a final Stock field), while a later section explicitly requires the stock attribute to be static (shared across all SealSaloon instances). This contradiction can confuse students about whether to implement stock as an instance final field or as a static (or static final) field.
issues.suggestedFix: Clarify the intended design in the problem statement: explicitly state whether stock should be an instance final field or a static (possibly static final) field. Preferably update the earlier sentence that mentions a 'final Stock stock' to say 'a static final Stock stock' (or remove the static requirement in the later note) so the specification consistently requires one design.

issues.description: The template Stock.getStockIngredients() returns a List<StockIngredient>, while the solution's Stock.getStockIngredients() returns a StockIngredient[] array. This mismatch in return type between template and reference solution is a structural inconsistency and may confuse students about which return type to use when interacting with stock ingredients.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent across template and reference solution. Either change the template's getStockIngredients() to return StockIngredient[] (recommended if arrays are used elsewhere in the exercise) or update the solution and any example usages to accept List<StockIngredient>. Also update the problem statement if it references a specific return type.
